description: List all forms with pagination metadata.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with total_items, page_count, and an items list of form summaries; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single form (including its fields) by its id.

form_id.description: The unique id of the form.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the full form object; on failure (form not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new form, optionally with an initial list of fields.

title.description: The title of the new form.

language.description: Optional language code for the form (default 'en').

is_public.description: Whether the form is public (default false).

fields.description: Optional list of field definitions (each with title, type, ref, required, and properties.choices).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created form object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update mutable fields (title, language, is_public) of an existing form.

form_id.description: The unique id of the form to update.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated form object; on failure (form not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a form and its associated fields, responses, and answers.

form_id.description: The unique id of the form to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {deleted: true, id: form_id}; on failure (form not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the responses submitted to a form, optionally filtered by completion state.

form_id.description: The unique id of the form.

completed.description: Optional completion filter; when set, only responses with this completed state are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with total_items, page_count, and an items list of response objects; on failure (form not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get an insights summary for a form, including completion rate and per-field aggregates.

form_id.description: The unique id of the form.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an insights object (total_responses, completed_responses, completion_rate, per-field summaries); on failure (form not found), output contains an error message.
